generic.selection: P>=2048, M divisible by 64, N divisible by 256
generic.pipeline: two K128-logical cp.async slots; each contains two independently scaled K64 groups accumulated in original order

paired_gate_up.selection: P>=2048, M divisible by 64, N divisible by 128
paired_gate_up.tile: M64N128K64 for each Gate and Up branch
paired_gate_up.pipeline: two K128-logical cp.async slots with pipeline/product shared-memory lifetime union

implementation.fallbacks: P1024 retains M64N64; C512 and nonaligned tails retain M32N128

real_openai_api_gate.authority: real authenticated model, exact tokenized OpenAI completions, output one, temperature zero
real_openai_api_gate.all_requests: HTTP 200 with exact usage and generated text Hello

correctness_and_resource_gates.generic: P2048 N256 K192 full output bit-exact, odd K64 tail and stride padding guard pass
correctness_and_resource_gates.paired: P2048 N128 K256 output codes/scales exact, NRMSE zero, byte-exact against retained M64N64 block reconstruction

prior_real_p2048_nsys.authority: retained M64N64 baseline attribution; not the wide-candidate profile
prior_real_p2048_nsys.finding: GEMM families were 65.9 percent of kernel time, but GDN plus full attention already approached 3 seconds and become the next hard floor as GEMM improves.

decision.reason: The wider-output skeleton produces a repeatable 24.9 to 34.5 percent gain over the retained M64N64 path while protecting P1024, but absolute P2048/P4096 throughput remains 7.5 to 9.1 times below the first target.
next_priority: Profile the retained wide route on the same real P2048 request
reduce K64-scale dequantization and FP32 accumulation frequency through a separately calibrated model-specific consumer policy
replace 6144 C16 GDN launches at P2048 with a whole-span or coarse-block fused update
then retest P8K through P40K and run the external EvalScope performance gate
